gloss: member of the Diet; member of parliament

definitions.gloss: member of the Diet; member of parliament
definitions.explanation: An elected member of Japan's national legislature ({国会|こっかい}). Includes both members of the House of Representatives ({衆議院|しゅうぎいん}) and the House of Councillors ({参議院|さんぎいん}).

examples.japanese: {国会議員|こっかいぎいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立候補|りっこうほ}→立候補：13778_rikkouho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To run for a seat in the Diet.

examples.japanese: {国会議員|こっかいぎいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{定数|ていすう}→定数：05149_teisuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{衆参|しゅうさん}⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧{七百名以上|ななひゃくめいいじょう}⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are over 700 members of the Diet between the two houses combined.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{国会議員|こっかいぎいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陳情|ちんじょう}→陳情：14663_chinjou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|たず}ねた→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧。
examples.english: I visited the office to petition the local Diet member.

notes:
The standard term for members of Japan's national parliament (⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧). In news reports, often shortened to ⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧ when the context is clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国会議員|こっかいぎいん}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧: Diet member election
- {国会議員|こっかいぎいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歳費|さいひ}: Diet member's salary
- {国会議員|こっかいぎいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be elected to the Diet
- {国会議員|こっかいぎいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{辞職|じしょく}→辞職：06157_jishoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to resign from the Diet

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}→衆議院議員：26590_shuugiingiin⟧: member of the House of Representatives
- {参議院議員|さんぎいんぎいん}: member of the House of Councillors
- {地方議員|ちほうぎいん}: local assembly member
- ⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧: legislator, council member — the general term
